methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UN News — Peace & Security is the topic-scoped RSS 2.0 feed of the United Nations news service (news.un.org) filtered to the peace-and-security desk. It reports on Security Council sessions, peacekeeping operations, conflict prevention, ceasefires, disarmament and political missions worldwide.

## Search
Client-side keyword filtering over RSS item title/description; no server query API. The feed URL scopes content to peace and security on the server side; any finer keyword match (a conflict, mission or country) must be applied in-memory as a substring scan over each item's title and description.

## Filters
Topic scoping to peace and security is fixed by the feed URL. Beyond that only client-side filters apply: publication date range (from pubDate) and keyword. Items carry no per-item `<category>`/`dc:subject` tags, so no secondary category filter is available.

## Download
The retrievable document is the item `<link>` HTML article page. Each item also has an `<enclosure>` pointing to a JPEG lead image, not a PDF; no direct document downloads are offered.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Not supported.

## Limitations
Feed returns only the most recent ~30 items; no historical pagination beyond the feed window and no archive parameter.
probeNotes: Reachable, valid RSS 2.0 with complete namespace declarations. Observed 30 items. Fields: title, link, description, guid, pubDate, enclosure (JPEG). No <category>/dc:subject tags. No PDF links.
